text:
mike_partnerships: Hey team — final pass on the NebulaCloud joint launch assets. Attached uploads: solution_brief_v3.pdf, social_tiles_v2.zip, nebula_lockup.png, nebula_icon.svg, case_excerpt.docx. Need quick checks: logo usage + clearspace, alt text for accessibility, legal ok on customer quote, copy signoff on 2 headline options, and social specs (sizes + CTA). Target publish Tue 08/13. @lina_design @sara_legal @tom_marketing

lina_design: Thanks — I can take logos + social tiles. Quick q: do we need the partner to approve the lockup or is co-branding pre-approved? Also will we use full-color or white-on-dark for tiles?

mike_partnerships: Partner signed the co-branding MOU but asked to review final lockups. So yes we need partner signoff on the lockup PNG. Use full-color on white backgrounds except where their brand requires dark background (see guideline note).

lina_design: Got it. Sharing proposed specs now.

lina_design: Logo files I'm uploading: 
nebula_lockup_300x.png
nebula_lockup_600x.png
nebula_icon_64.svg
nebula_icon_128.svg
Alt text suggestions: 
- "NebulaCloud lockup with Redwood Inference"
- "NebulaCloud icon"
Which one should go on the solution brief cover vs. the social tiles?

tom_marketing: For social tiles: primary tile = feature highlight (1200x628, CTA: Learn more), secondary = customer quote (1080x1080, CTA: Read case study). For copy, two headline variants: 
A) "Redwood + NebulaCloud: Faster LLM inference at scale"
B) "Ship LLM features with lower latency and predictable costs"
Which do you prefer?

jess_product: Heads up — in the solution brief we call out "continuous batching" and "KV cache sharing". The partner brief lists "KV cache pooling" — we should standardize language. Recommend we use "KV cache" and provide 1-sentence description to avoid mismatch.

sara_legal: Quick legal note: the customer quote in case_excerpt.docx references an identifiable client and a PII example. We need explicit written permission from the customer to publish that quote + anonymize the PII before release. Also confirm NebulaCloud has approved the logo lockup and usage for paid advertising (some partners restrict paid channels).

mike_partnerships: Sara — can you draft the permission email template we should send to the customer? I'll loop in partner AM.

sara_legal: Yep. I'll draft and post here in ~30m. It will include: explicit quote text, scope of use (web, social, press), duration, and opt-out clause.

assetbot: Uploaded files: https://redwood-assets.internal/nebula/solution_brief_v3.pdf, https://redwood-assets.internal/nebula/social_tiles_v2.zip, https://redwood-assets.internal/nebula/logos/nebula_lockup_600x.png

lina_design: Quick mock screenshots attached. For the solution brief cover I recommend: nebula_lockup_600x.png centered left, headline variant A (shorter), alt text "NebulaCloud lockup with Redwood Inference". For social, two tile sets: one brand-forward + CTA, one quote-forward with customer logo masked.

tom_marketing: I prefer headline A for the landing page. For social, use headline B as the in-post caption so we cover both angles.

jess_product: Confirming we will not call out any deprecated API names — using the latest names in v3 brief. I updated one line in the doc (see solution_brief_v3.pdf).

mike_partnerships: Next steps: 
- @sara_legal posts permission email template (EOD)
- @lina_design finalize lockups and export white/dark variants (by EOD)
- @tom_marketing finalize copy and scheduling for socials (by Mon)
- @jess_product confirm feature wording in final brief (done)
I will ping partner AM for lockup signoff once legal template is ready. Thanks all :thumbsup:

sara_legal: Posted template below — please review and flag any customer-specific language before I send.

sara_legal: "Hi [Customer Name],
We are planning to publish a short case excerpt featuring your quote about performance improvements after migrating inference to Redwood + NebulaCloud. Please reply with approval to publish the attached quote and confirm the scope (web, social, press). Respond by [date]. If no reply, we will follow up via the partner AM."

lina_design: Reviewing — will anonymize PII in the mock tiles.

mike_partnerships: Perfect. I'll hold off on final upload until partner signoff. Thanks team.
